R1.description: The descriptor probe's positive control decides whether the host can list sockets from what the first existing directory of _FD_DIRECTORIES shows (an open socket's descriptor as a symbolic link, not merely that the directory exists) and skips with the probe's own wording; a test fails when the control keeps a literal path, its own wording or an existence-only decision, on a missing directory and on a directory of regular files

R2.description: The probe and its control look for the socket pair's own links (socket:[inode] from os.fstat of each end) instead of counting two new links in a before/after difference; a bystander pair opened after the first listing and kept open, and a growing-listing probe case, fail a return to counting; mutations that leave one end open or name the wrong inode fail the control, and one that leaks a socket link from the bounded read fails the leak checks

R3.description: The unexercised recv_into and fileno setup lines are deleted from the two bounded-wrapper tests that carry them, with no assertion changed

R4.description: Row 31 of the roadmap is Current while the item runs and Done at acceptance; the title is a test: change that releases nothing; only tests/test_discovery.py changes outside the bookkeeping, with no src/ change
